name: mcp-feedback
description: Agent feedback for MCP servers: skills for dropping the mcp-feedback library into a server, filing feedback through submit_feedback, and synthesizing and closing out what was collected, over MCP reader tools or the mcp-feedback CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Collect and act on agent feedback for MCP servers
interface.longDescription: Adds a feedback loop to MCP servers. Agents using a server file structured feedback about failures, friction and missing capabilities; each report is tied to the authenticated caller and stored in SQLite, Postgres or a store you write. These skills cover integrating the library into a server, filing good feedback, and reading, clustering and closing out what was collected.
defaultPrompt: Add agent feedback to this MCP server
Summarize the feedback agents filed this week
Close out the feedback we fixed in the last release
